subject: Renewal: Consolidated 3yr staircase + embedded burst rights — ops checklist
messages:
From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Procuremen t <procure@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Legal <legal@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal — 3yr staircase w/ embedded burst rights

Vivek / team,

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, Nimbus is prepared to move to a consolidated 3-year agreement that lets us scale predictably while giving us flexibility around occasional spike capacity for seasonal pilots. High level ask from our side: a staircase (year-over-year increase) with an embedded burst pool that can be consumed at defined uplift triggers. Key items we need spelled out:

- Clear ramp schedule by quarter (year 1 baseline, year 2+ increases)
- Burst mechanics: activation triggers, per-token pricing, and invoice treatment
- Auto-renew opt-out clause (we need the right to decline auto-renew with 60 days notice)
- Billing cadence and any prepay requirements for burst reserves
- SLA credits and how they scale with capacity tiers

Attached is a short LOI outlining the commercial concept (we'll sign once we lock the SOW). Can you put together an ops checklist + draft SOW changes and confirm timing for an internal review?

Appreciate it — Sara

Attachment: Signed-LOI.pdf (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — 3yr staircase w/ embedded burst rights

Sara — thanks, and great to hear Nimbus is ready to commit longer term. We'll do the ops checklist and a redline-friendly SOW summary. Quick answers up front:

- We can model a 3-year staircase with quarterly checkpoints and a definable burst pool that draws from an unlocked capacity bucket.
- Burst invoicing options: (A) draw-from-prepaid-pool (recommended for predictability) or (B) pay-as-you-go at uplift rate. We'll outline both.
- Auto-renew: we can include an opt-out notice window; finance prefers 90 days, but we can make 60 days work with a contractual exception.
- SLA credits: we will map credits to committed tier (higher tiers get larger credit multipliers).

I'm looping in Laura (ops) and Camila (finance/onboarding) to produce the checklist and the Tiered-Ramp spreadsheet. Jonas — I'll need legal and commercial guidance on the mid-term uplift window and language around burst rights.

Next step: Laura to share an ops checklist + initial spreadsheet by EOD Mon (16 Nov). Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lee <sara.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Ops checklist + draft ramp spreadsheet (attached)

Vivek / Camila / Sara — attaching the Tiered-Ramp-Spreadsheet.xlsx and a short ops checklist. Summary below:

Ops checklist (action owners in parens):
1) Confirm baseline throughput profile and peak delta by month (Nimbus / Customer engineering)
2) Define staircase percentages and timing (Sales + Customer) — propose +20% Y2, +15% Y3 by default
3) Burst pool sizing and billing model selection (Camila / Finance) — recommend prepaid pool with monthly reconciliation
4) Activation triggers for burst (Ops):
   - Soft trigger: sustained 10%+ above baseline for 3 rolling days -> notify + optional auto-assign from burst pool
   - Hard trigger: sustained 30%+ for 24 hours -> auto-assign with alert to both parties
5) Metrics to expose in console for chargeback (Redwood Console tag requirements) (Ops)
6) SLA mapping and credit table (Legal + Finance)
7) Implementation sprint & cutover plan: staging window + smoke test + rollback plan (Ops)

Attachments included: Tiered-Ramp-Spreadsheet.xlsx (seeded with baseline / burst options)

Open questions for Nimbus:
- Do you prefer the prepaid burst pool or pay-as-you-go?
- Any internal constraints on invoice frequency or prepay?

I'll take action to convert the checklist into SOW language once we confirm the billing model.

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lee <sara.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ops checklist + draft ramp spreadsheet (attached)

Quick legal/commercial note:
- Mid-term uplift window: we can allow a one-time mid-term uplift (market-rate pricing for incremental capacity) between months 12-18, with a defined recalibration to the staircase if the uplift is sustained for >90 days. That needs explicit language in section 4 of the SOW.
- Auto-renew opt-out: accept 60-day notice, but include a clause that redistributes any prepaid burst balance pro-rata on termination.
- If they pick pay-as-you-go for burst, include a floor (e.g., 10% of baseline monthly) to preserve minimum billing economics.

I'll draft the clause and send markup by EOD. Jonas

Jonas Weber
VP Commercial | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procuremen t <procure@nimbushealth.com>, legal@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — ops checklist received

Vivek / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the spreadsheet. Nimbus prefers the prepaid burst pool for predictability; we'll fund an initial 3-month reserve and re-evaluate after Q1. The mid-term uplift window sounds reasonable as proposed. Two asks before we start SOW redlines:

1) Can you include the prepaid pool invoiced as a separate line item with a simple reconciliation statement each month?
2) We need a clause that allows Nimbus to withdraw from auto-renew within 60 days without penalty (except for pro-rata treatment of prepaid bursts as noted).

If you can bake those items into the draft SOW, I can route to Procurement and Legal for sign-off. Attaching the LOI we referenced for signature.

Sara

Attachment: Nimbus_SOW_v3.pdf (stub); Signed-LOI.pdf (stub)
